description: Na₆MgMo₂(NO₃)₂ crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are six inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to one N and three O atoms to form NaNO₃ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent MgNO₄ square pyramids, corners with four MoNO₃ tetrahedra, and corners with six NaNO₃ tetrahedra. The Na-N bond length is 2.42 Å. There are two shorter (2.43 Å) and one longer (2.44 Å) Na-O bond length. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to one N and three O atoms to form NaNO₃ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one MgNO₄ square pyramid, corners with four MoNO₃ tetrahedra, and corners with six NaNO₃ tetrahedra. The Na-N bond length is 2.33 Å. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.57 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to one N and three O atoms to form NaNO₃ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent MgNO₄ square pyramids, corners with four NaNO₃ tetrahedra, and corners with four MoNO₃ tetrahedra. The Na-N bond length is 2.36 Å. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.56 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one N and three O atoms. The Na-N bond length is 2.54 Å. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.22-2.38 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one N and three O atoms. The Na-N bond length is 2.56 Å. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.19-2.38 Å. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded to one N and three O atoms to form NaNO₃ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent MgNO₄ square pyramids, corners with four NaNO₃ tetrahedra, and corners with four MoNO₃ tetrahedra. The Na-N bond length is 2.54 Å. There is one shorter (2.39 Å) and two longer (2.41 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Mg is bonded to one N and four O atoms to form distorted MgNO₄ square pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one MoNO₃ tetrahedra, corners with eight NaNO₃ tetrahedra, and edges with two MoNO₃ tetrahedra. The Mg-N bond length is 2.15 Å. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.09-2.13 Å. There are two inequivalent Mo sites. In the first Mo site, Mo is bonded to one N and three O atoms to form MoNO₃ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one MgNO₄ square pyramid, corners with eight NaNO₃ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one MgNO₄ square pyramid. The Mo-N bond length is 1.80 Å. There is one shorter (1.88 Å) and two longer (2.00 Å) Mo-O bond lengths. In the second Mo site, Mo is bonded to one N and three O atoms to form MoNO₃ tetrahedra that share corners with eight NaNO₃ tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one MgNO₄ square pyramid. The Mo-N bond length is 1.75 Å. There is one shorter (1.90 Å) and two longer (2.02 Å) Mo-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent N sites. In the first N site, N is bonded to three Na and one Mo atom to form NNa₃Mo tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent ONa₃MgMo square pyramids, corners with four ONa₃MgMo trigonal bipyramids, and corners with four ONa₃Mo trigonal pyramids. In the second N site, N is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mg, and one Mo atom. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Mg, and one Mo atom to form distorted ONa₃MgMo trigonal bipyramids that share corners with three equivalent ONa₃MgMo square pyramids, corners with two equivalent NNa₃Mo tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one ONa₃MgMo trigonal bipyramid, corners with two equivalent ONa₃Mo trigonal pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₃MgMo trigonal bipyramid. In the second O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Mg, and one Mo atom to form distorted ONa₃MgMo square pyramids that share corners with two equivalent NNa₃Mo tetrahedra, corners with four ONa₃MgMo trigonal bipyramids, corners with two equivalent ONa₃Mo trigonal pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₃MgMo trigonal bipyramid. In the third O site, O is bonded to three Na and one Mo atom to form distorted ONa₃Mo trigonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent ONa₃MgMo square pyramids, corners with two equivalent NNa₃Mo tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent ONa₃MgMo trigonal bipyramids, and corners with two equivalent ONa₃Mo trigonal pyramids. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to three Na and one Mo atom to form distorted ONa₃Mo trigonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent NNa₃Mo tetrahedra, corners with four ONa₃MgMo trigonal bipyramids, and corners with two equivalent ONa₃Mo trigonal pyramids. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mg, and one Mo atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Mg, and one Mo atom to form distorted ONa₃MgMo trigonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one ONa₃MgMo square pyramid, corners with two equivalent NNa₃Mo tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one ONa₃MgMo trigonal bipyramid, corners with four ONa₃Mo trigonal pyramids,  an edgeedge with one ONa₃MgMo square pyramid, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₃MgMo trigonal bipyramid.
